"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to their base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    # NFKD splits "è" into "e" + combining grave; dropping non-ASCII keeps the base letter.
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
